title: Navier-Stokes Existence and Smoothness: Fefferman A
summary: Prove Fefferman statement (A): for every viscosity nu > 0 and every real smooth divergence-free Schwartz vector field u0 on R^3, with force f identically zero, there are real velocity u and pressure p in C-infinity(R^3 x [0,infinity)) satisfying partial_t u + (u dot grad)u = nu Delta u - grad p, div u = 0 and u(x,0) = u0(x). The velocity energy integral over R^3 of |u(x,t)|^2 is bounded above by one finite constant for all t >= 0; that constant may depend on u0 and nu. Schwartz means every spatial derivative decays faster than every inverse polynomial, as in official condition (4). Smoothness includes time zero. The selected domain is whole space, not the torus.
honesty_statement: Formal Lean 4 proof or counterexample checked with zero sorry statements and zero custom axioms, or a verified partial reduction and barrier map. Partial progress is never labeled solved.

title: Global Langlands Functoriality Conjecture
summary: For every number field F, quasisplit connected reductive F-groups G-prime and G, and admissible L-homomorphism rho:L(G-prime)->L(G) (over Gamma_F, commuting with its projections, in Arthur Principle1.1's convention), every automorphic representation pi-prime of G-prime(A_F), in the inclusive Langlands sense cited there, has an automorphic representation pi of G(A_F) whose unramified Satake classes equal the images under rho_v of those of pi-prime outside a finite set of places. This is existence of a weak transfer, not uniqueness or a prescribed transfer function.

title: NP versus P/poly
summary: Determine the truth of NP subseteq P/poly. Here NP consists of languages over finite binary strings accepted by nondeterministic Turing machines in polynomial time. P/poly consists of languages L for which there exist constants C>=1 and integer k>=1 and Boolean circuits C_n for all n>=0, of size at most C(n+1)^k, deciding membership in L on every length-n input. Circuits are finite acyclic single-output circuits with fan-in-two AND/OR, fan-in-one NOT, input bits and hardwired constants0/1; count all nodes. Each language has its own bound and circuit family, with no uniform generation requirement.
honesty_statement: Formal Lean 4 proof or counterexample checked with zero sorry statements and zero custom axioms, or a verified partial reduction and barrier map. Partial progress is never labeled solved.

title: Matrix-Multiplication Exponent Equals Two

title: Equivariant Tamagawa number conjecture: Burns-Flach Conjecture4 package
summary: For every motive M over a number field K in Burns-Flach Section3.1's motivic-structure formalism, with an action of a finite-dimensional semisimple Q-algebra A, and every order mathcal A in A admitting the compatible projective mathcal A-structure of Section3.3, prove Burns-Flach Conjecture4(i)-(iv) in its stated conditional setting. The external defining hypotheses are the finite motivic cohomology and real comparison exact sequence of Conjecture1, the motivic-to-p-adic comparison of Conjecture2 for M and Mdual(1), coefficient compatibility giving well-defined equivariant local factors as in4.1 (Conjecture3 or the weaker Euler-factor compatibility of Remark7), and the stated Coherence hypothesis. A projective structure consists of full projective lattices in the archimedean realizations whose l-adic comparison images agree and are Galois-stable, not merely an arbitrary maximal-order choice. The INCLUDED assertions are: (i) the finite equivariant L-function L(AM,s) has meromorphic continuation to0; (ii) its componentwise integer order r equals rr_A(H_f^1(K,Mdual(1))^*)-rr_A(H_f^0(K,Mdual(1))^*), with reduced rank as in2.6; (iii) for the nonzero componentwise leading Laurent coefficient L*(AM,0)=lim_(s->0) s^(-r)L(AM,s), the class T_Omega=delta_hat^1_(mathcal A,R)(L*(AM,0))+R_Omega(M,mathcal A) lies in Cl(mathcal A,Q); and (iv) T_Omega=0 in Cl(mathcal A,R), hence in K_0(mathcal A,R). The R_Omega term is the class of the fundamental virtual object with its integral compact-support cohomology structures and real comparison trivialization in3.4; delta_hat is Lemma9's canonical extended reduced-norm boundary, not an inverse to a surjective real reduced norm. Equivalently the final identity is delta_hat(L*)=-R_Omega. Preserve graded determinant conventions and all suitable nonmaximal/noncommutative orders. Coherence-free Remark8's Conjecture5 and Conjecture6 for EVERY prime are an alternative to the rational/integral clauses in the source's stated sense, not removal of(i)-(ii) or replacement by a single p-local or epsilon assertion. The external hypotheses are not presumed universally proved or restricted to currently established cases, and proving all of them is not added as a separate conclusion.

title: Existence of One-Way Permutations
summary: There exists a family f_n:{0,1}^n->{0,1}^n, n>=1, of bijections computed by one deterministic polynomial-time algorithm on (1^n,x), such that for every probabilistic polynomial-time algorithm A its inversion success Pr[A(1^n,f_n(x))=x], over uniform x and A's coins, is negligible in n: for every c>0 it is at most n^(-c) for all sufficiently large n. title: Deligne conjecture on coefficient-equivariant critical motivic L-values
summary: For every pure motive M over Q with coefficients in a number field E, in Deligne's geometric realization formalism (Betti, de Rham and compatible l-adic realizations with comparison, dual, tensor and Tate-twist structures), and every critical integer n, the normalized finite L-value vector L(M,n)/((2*pi*i)^(n*d_sign)*c^sign(M)) lies in the diagonal E inside E tensor C, where sign=(-1)^n and d_sign=dim_E H_B^sign(M). Here H_B^sign is the sign eigenspace of complex conjugation, and c^sign is the determinant of the Betti/de Rham comparison to the corresponding filtration quotient, computed in E-rational bases and defined modulo E-units as in Deligne1.7/2.6. Critical means that L_infinity(sigma,M,s) and L_infinity(sigma,Mdual,1-s) have no pole at s=n for every embedding sigma:E->C (equivalently use Mdual(1) at -s). Use finite, not completed, L-functions with the compatible E-valued local factors of2.2. Analytic continuation giving finite values at the selected critical integer and the source's well-defined compatible realizations/local factors are defining prerequisites, not assertions proved by this period law and not a restriction to cases whose continuation is already known. The simultaneous embedding vector must come from one element of E; unrelated componentwise algebraicity is insufficient. All-zero values are allowed, but mixed zero/nonzero components do not satisfy the diagonal membership. No general nonvanishing or order-of-zero assertion from Deligne2.7 is appended.
honesty_statement: Formal Lean 4 proof or counterexample checked with zero sorry statements and zero custom axioms, or a verified partial reduction and barrier map. Partial progress is never labeled solved.

title: Weight–Monodromy Conjecture
summary: Let K be ANY nonarchimedean local field with finite residue field F_q of characteristic p, X ANY proper smooth variety over K, i>=0, and l ANY prime different from p. Put V=H^i_et(X_over_Kbar,Qbar_l), retaining the original K. On an open inertia subgroup the action is unipotent and defines nilpotent monodromy N:V->V(-1), with its Galois-equivariant Tate twist. Let M be the unique increasing monodromy filtration centred at zero: N(M_j) is contained in M_(j-2)(-1), and N^a:gr^M_a(V)->gr^M_(-a)(V)(-a) is an isomorphism for every a>=0. For EVERY integer j and ANY lift Phi of geometric Frobenius of F_q, every eigenvalue alpha on gr^M_j(V) is conjectured to be algebraic and have absolute value q^((i+j)/2) under ALL complex embeddings. This is purity of weight i+j. Defining N on an open inertia subgroup does not replace K or q. Finite-extension proof reductions must change cardinality and Frobenius consistently. Extending l-adic coefficients does not change the target. The equivalent source convention compares zero-centred M_j with W_(i+j); weight-filtration existence is not an added unresolved assertion. No restriction to projective, semistable, geometrically connected or special complete-intersection varieties is imposed. l=p, crystalline, torsion and arbitrary rigid-analytic analogues are not substituted.
honesty_statement: Formal Lean 4 proof or counterexample checked with zero sorry statements and zero custom axioms, or a verified partial reduction and barrier map. Partial progress is never labeled solved.

title: Campana's Conjecture Characterizing Special Varieties by Potential Density of Rational Points
summary: For every number field K and every smooth projective geometrically integral variety X/K, prove or disprove that X over an algebraic closure of K is special in Campana's sense if and only if X(L) is Zariski dense in X for some finite extension L/K. Here specialness has its usual projective meaning: for each integer 1<=p<=dim X and rank-one coherent subsheaf F of the sheaf of algebraic p-forms on X over the algebraic closure, the Kodaira dimension kappa(F) is less than p (equivalently, the Campana core is a point). A proof must establish the biconditional for all such X; one counterexample to either implication refutes it. This target excludes nonproper integral-point, weakly-special, analytic and function-field variants.

title: PSPACE versus EXPTIME
summary: Determine whether PSPACE=EXPTIME for languages over finite binary strings in the standard deterministic multitape Turing-machine model with a read-only input tape and work tapes. PSPACE is the union over integers k>=1 of DSPACE(n^k), with asymptotic constant factors allowed and read-only input cells not counted as work space. EXPTIME is the union over integers k>=1 of DTIME(2^(n^k)), with asymptotic constant factors allowed. Machines are total deciders that halt on every input. This is an unrelativized equality of the full classes, not of one fixed resource exponent.
honesty_statement: Formal Lean 4 proof or counterexample checked with zero sorry statements and zero custom axioms, or a verified partial reduction and barrier map. Partial progress is never labeled solved.

title: Grothendieck Standard Conjecture of Hodge Type
summary: For every smooth projective irreducible variety X of dimension n over an algebraically closed field k of any characteristic and every ample divisor class L, put N^i(X)_Q equal to codimension-i algebraic cycles with rational coefficients modulo numerical equivalence, with N^j=0 outside 0<=j<=n. For each integer 0<=i<=n/2 let P_L^i=ker(L^(n-2i+1):N^i(X)_Q -> N^(n-i+1)(X)_Q). The numerical standard conjecture of Hodge type asserts that q_L^i(a,b)=(-1)^i deg(a.b.L^(n-2i)) is positive definite on P_L^i after extending scalars to R. This is numerical primitive positivity, not an unconditional identification with primitive algebraic cohomology for an arbitrary Weil theory; it does not assume or require proving the other standard conjectures separately.

title: Serre's congruence subgroup conjecture
summary: Let K be a global field (a number field or the function field of a curve over a finite field), G an absolutely almost simple simply connected algebraic K-group, and S a finite nonempty set of places of K containing every archimedean place when K is a number field. Put r_S(G) = sum over v in S of rank_{K_v}(G), and let C^S(G) be the kernel of the natural surjection from the profinite completion of G(O_S) (S-arithmetic topology) onto its S-congruence completion. Prove Serre's congruence subgroup conjecture: (a) if r_S(G) >= 2 and rank_{K_v}(G) > 0 for every nonarchimedean v in S, then C^S(G) is finite; (b) if r_S(G) = 1, then C^S(G) is infinite. The case r_S(G) = 0 (finite G(O_S), trivial kernel) is excluded. Finiteness of C^S(G) is the assertion; triviality is a stronger statement not required. Which specific groups remain unsettled is status information, not part of the target.

title: Cohen-Lenstra class-group distributions for quadratic number fields
summary: For u in {0,1} let K_u(X) be the set of isomorphism classes of quadratic number fields K with |disc(K)| < X that are imaginary (u = 0) or real (u = 1). For each fixed odd prime p and each finite abelian p-group A, prove that the limit as X tends to infinity of #{K in K_u(X) : Cl(K)[p^infinity] is isomorphic to A} / #K_u(X) exists and equals (1/Z_u(p)) * |A|^{-u} / |Aut(A)|, where Z_u(p) is the sum over isomorphism classes of finite abelian p-groups B of |B|^{-u}/|Aut(B)| (so Z_0(p) = prod_{i>=1}(1-p^{-i})^{-1} and Z_1(p) = prod_{i>=2}(1-p^{-i})^{-1}). Cl(K) is the ordinary ideal class group and Cl(K)[p^infinity] its Sylow p-subgroup. No assertion is made for p = 2, for narrow class groups, for a joint law over several primes, or for any non-quadratic family.

title: Existence of a Length-Optimal Propositional Proof System
summary: Does there exist a polynomial-time computable function P from finite binary strings onto the encodings of all propositional tautologies such that, for every polynomial-time computable function Q onto the same tautologies, there is a polynomial q_Q for which every Q-proof pi has some P-proof sigma with P(sigma)=Q(pi) and |sigma| <= q_Q(|pi|)? The polynomial may depend on Q. No polynomial-time algorithm for finding sigma from pi is required. This is the ordinary unrelativized Cook–Reckhow setting without advice or randomness; resolve existence or nonexistence of such P.

title: Hyperlinearity of Every Group
summary: Determine whether every group G is hyperlinear. Precisely, for each finite F contained in G and each epsilon>0, must there be d>=1 and phi:F->U(d) such that ||phi(g)phi(h)-phi(gh)||_(2,d)<epsilon whenever g,h,gh belong to F, and ||phi(g)-I||_(2,d)>sqrt(2)-epsilon for every nonidentity g in F? Here ||X||_(2,d)=(Tr(X*X)/d)^(1/2) is the normalized Hilbert-Schmidt norm. A negative resolution is a group failing this condition.

title: Torsion Conjecture for Abelian Varieties of Dimension at Least Two
summary: For every integer g>=2 and every number field K, there exists a finite constant B(g,K) such that every abelian variety A defined over K of dimension g satisfies #A(K)_tors <= B(g,K). Here A(K)_tors is the subgroup of K-rational torsion points. The bound is uniform over all such A, without dependence on A, its height, endomorphisms, polarization degree or reduction type; it may depend on g and K. No effective formula, explicit numerical value or classification of torsion groups is required.

title: Global Gan–Gross–Prasad Conjecture (Fixed-Representation Form)
summary: For every number field F, let E be F, a quadratic extension, or F×F, and let W⊂V be a nondegenerate relevant pair with form sign epsilon, split W-perp, and epsilon*(-1)^dim(W-perp)=-1; a two-dimensional orthogonal V or W is required to be nonsplit. Use exactly the groups, covers, Bessel/Fourier–Jacobi representation nu and auxiliary data of Gan–Gross–Prasad Section 23, and R of Section 24, including the skew-hermitian character mu and its matching inverse twist in R. For every irreducible tempered representation pi occurring with multiplicity one in the cuspidal automorphic spectrum, Conjecture 24.1 asserts: the global period F(nu) is nonzero on pi if and only if Hom_H(F_v)(pi_v,nu_v) is nonzero for every place v and L(pi,R,1/2) is nonzero. Quantification is over all data permitted there, including relevant orthogonal, hermitian, symplectic/metaplectic and skew-hermitian cases. This is the fixed-representation equivalence, not the refined period identity or packet-existence formulation.
honesty_statement: Formal Lean 4 proof or counterexample checked with zero sorry statements and zero custom axioms, or a verified partial reduction and barrier map. Partial progress is never labeled solved.

title: Uniform Subconvexity for Standard Automorphic L-Functions on GL(n)
summary: For every integer n≥1 and every number field F, there exist constants δ(n,F)>0 and A(n,F)>0 such that |L(1/2,π)|≤A(n,F) C(π)^(1/4−δ(n,F)) for every unitary cuspidal automorphic representation π of GL_n(A_F), where L(s,π) is the standard finite-part L-function and C(π) its analytic conductor. The bound must be uniform simultaneously in all finite and archimedean parameters of π; imaginary unitary twists are included. Any fixed positive exponent saving suffices; the optimal exponent is not requested.

title: Murre's Chow-Kunneth Conjectures
summary: For every smooth projective irreducible complex variety X of dimension d, let CH^j(X)_Q denote cycles modulo rational equivalence, with Betti Q-cohomology. A correspondence pi in CH^d(X x X)_Q acts by pi_*(a)=(p_2)_*(p_1^*(a).pi). Murre's full A-D package asserts: (A) there exists a Chow-Kunneth decomposition, namely mutually orthogonal composition-idempotents pi_0,...,pi_(2d) in CH^d(X x X)_Q summing to the diagonal and inducing projection onto H^i(X,Q) for pi_i; (B) for EVERY such decomposition and 0<=j<=d, pi_i acts as zero on CH^j when i<j or i>2j; (C) for EVERY such decomposition define F^r CH^j as the intersection of ker(pi_i)_* for max(0,2j-r+1)<=i<=2j, r>=0, with empty intersection F^0=CH^j; these filtrations are equal for ALL decompositions satisfying A; (D) for EVERY such decomposition, F^1 CH^j equals ker(CH^j(X)_Q -> H^(2j)(X,Q)). Under A and B, F^(j+1)=0. No multiplicative or self-dual decomposition, explicit construction algorithm, functorial-extra requirement, or arbitrary-base-field enlargement is included.
honesty_statement: Formal Lean 4 proof or counterexample checked with zero sorry statements and zero custom axioms, or a verified partial reduction and barrier map. Partial progress is never labeled solved.

title: Planted Clique Conjecture
summary: For every fixed real alpha with 0<alpha<1/2, set k_n=floor(n^(1/2-alpha)). Sample a uniform k_n-subset S of n labeled vertices, put every edge inside S, and independently include each other edge with probability1/2. There is no randomized algorithm running in time polynomial in n that, given this graph, outputs exactly S with probability tending to1 as n tends to infinity, over S, remaining edges and its internal coins. Algorithms may depend on the fixed alpha but receive no advice depending on n.

title: Tate's rational leading-term Stark conjecture
summary: For every finite Galois extension L/K of number fields with group G, let S be any finite set of places of K containing the archimedean and ramified places. Let X be the augmentation kernel of the free Q-module on places of L above S, U=Q tensor_Z O_(L,S)^*, and f:X->U any Q[G]-isomorphism. Define lambda:R tensor U->R tensor X by lambda(u)=-sum_w log|u|_w w, using product-formula normalized absolute values. For each irreducible complex character chi of G, set R_S(chi,f)=det_C(lambda f acting by postcomposition on Hom_C[G](V_(dual chi),C tensor X)) and A_S(chi,f)=R_S(chi,f)/L_S^*(0,chi), where L_S^* is the first nonzero Laurent coefficient of the S-truncated Artin L-function and an empty determinant is1. Is A_S(chi,f) in Q(chi), with sigma(A_S(chi,f))=A_S(chi^sigma,f) for every sigma in Aut(C)?

title: Voevodsky's Smash-Nilpotence Conjecture
summary: For every field k, every smooth projective k-variety X of dimension d, every integer 0<=r<=d, and every class alpha in CH^r(X)_Q (codimension-r cycles modulo rational equivalence with rational coefficients), assume deg(alpha.beta)=0 for every beta in CH^(d-r)(X)_Q. Voevodsky's smash-nilpotence assertion is that there exists an integer N>=1, depending on alpha, for which the N-fold EXTERNAL product alpha times ... times alpha is zero in CH^(Nr)(X^N)_Q, where X^N is the fibre product over k. No algebraic-closure, characteristic-zero or geometric-connectedness hypothesis is imposed; disconnected smooth projective schemes are interpreted on their pure-dimensional components. The reverse implication, smash-nilpotent implies numerically trivial, is known, so this is equality of numerical and smash equivalence for rational cycles. Neither intersection powers on X, composition powers of correspondences, integral coefficients, nor a uniform or computable exponent replaces this assertion.
honesty_statement: Formal Lean 4 proof or counterexample checked with zero sorry statements and zero custom axioms, or a verified partial reduction and barrier map. Partial progress is never labeled solved.

title: Inhomogeneous Landau–Coulomb Global Regularity (HST All-Moment Data)
summary: Fix a positive physical constant a. On [0,infinity) times R^3_x times R^3_v consider the classical Landau equation (partial_t+v dot grad_x)f=Q(f,f), where Q(f,f)=div_v integral_{R^3} A(v-w)[f(t,x,w) grad_v f(t,x,v)-f(t,x,v) grad_w f(t,x,w)]dw and A(z)=a |z|^(-1)(I-z tensor z/|z|^2) for z!=0. For every nonnegative initial datum f_0 on R^6 with f_0 in the global Holder space C^alpha for some 0<alpha<1, sup_{x,v}<v>^k f_0(x,v)<infinity for every k>=0, and constants delta,r_0,R>0 such that for every x there exists |v_x|<R with f_0>=delta on the Euclidean R^6 ball B_{r_0}(x,v_x), does the classical solution branch constructed in HST Theorems 1.2–1.4 have maximal continuation time T_E=infinity? Here <v>=(1+|v|^2)^(1/2); the branch matches f_0 as t decreases to zero, is smooth for positive time, and has all polynomial velocity weights bounded on every finite time slab of its existence. The exact question is global extension of that branch, with the sufficiently decaying uniformly continuous kinetic weak uniqueness convention in HST Section 5, not uniqueness among all generalized weak solutions. The HST Coulomb continuation quantity is Psi(T)=esssup_{0<=t<=T,x} integral f(t,x,v)dv + esssup_{0<=t<=T,x,v} f(t,x,v). Finite Psi on every finite time slab is the associated continuation criterion, not an extra hypothesis presumed true. No smallness near equilibrium, finite total spatial mass or uniform bound across different initial data is imposed.

title: Morton–Silverman Uniform Boundedness Conjecture
summary: For all fixed integers N>=1, d>=2 and D>=1, there exists a finite constant C(N,d,D) such that for every number field K with [K:Q]<=D and every degree-d K-morphism phi:P^N_K->P^N_K, the set of K-rational preperiodic points has cardinality at most C(N,d,D). A point is preperiodic when its forward orbit under phi is finite. The morphism is everywhere defined, equivalently given by homogeneous degree-d forms with no common projective zero. The bound is independent of the field and map except for N,d,D; no effective formula or classification is required.

title: Parity conjecture for elliptic curves
summary: For every number field K and every elliptic curve E/K, is w(E/K)=(-1)^rank_Z E(K), where rank_Z E(K) is the Mordell-Weil rank and w(E/K)=product_v w(E/K_v) is the global root number? The local factors are the usual Weil-Deligne root numbers at finite places, equal to1 at all but finitely many places, and -1 at every archimedean place; their definition does not assume analytic continuation of L(E/K,s).

title: Simpson's Motivicity Conjecture for Rigid Local Systems
summary: Let X be a smooth connected complex quasi-projective variety with a smooth normal-crossings compactification, and let L be an irreducible complex local system of any finite positive rank. Assume its determinant has finite order, its monodromies around the boundary components are quasi-unipotent, and L is rigid: an isolated point in the moduli space with its determinant and boundary monodromy conjugacy classes fixed. Prove or disprove that L is of geometric origin: there exist a dense Zariski-open U in X, a smooth projective morphism f:Y to U, and an integer i>=0 such that L restricted to U is a direct summand of R^i f_* C_Y.

title: UCT Problem for Separable Nuclear Complex C*-Algebras
summary: Decide whether EVERY separable nuclear complex C*-algebra A, unital or nonunital, satisfies the Rosenberg-Schochet UCT: for EVERY separable complex C*-algebra B, unital or nonunital, and each j in Z/2, the canonical UCT sequence 0 -> E_j(A,B) -> KK_j(A,B) -> H_j(A,B) -> 0 is exact. Here H_j(A,B)=direct_sum_(i=0,1) Hom_Z(K_i(A),K_(i+j)(B)) and E_j(A,B)=direct_sum_(i=0,1) Ext_Z^1(K_i(A),K_(i+j+1)(B)), with indices modulo2. The right map is the natural map on K-theory induced by KK classes; the left is the canonical inverse extension-class identification of the kernel, not an arbitrary chosen injection. No canonical or natural splitting is required. Equivalently, every such A belongs to the Rosenberg-Schochet bootstrap category of separable nuclear C*-algebras, or is KK-equivalent to a separable commutative complex C*-algebra.
honesty_statement: Formal Lean 4 proof or counterexample checked with zero sorry statements and zero custom axioms, or a verified partial reduction and barrier map. Partial progress is never labeled solved.

title: Palis finite-attractor full-basin density conjecture
summary: For every compact connected boundaryless smooth manifold M and every finite integer r >= 1, prove the conjunction of the following two density assertions: (i) in Diff^r(M) with its C^r topology there is a dense subset D whose elements f have finitely many attractors whose basins of attraction together cover M up to a set of smooth-volume measure zero; (ii) the same holds in the space X^r(M) of C^r vector fields with its C^r topology, for the attractors and basins of the generated flows. Attractor follows Palis (2005) Sections 2.1 and 2.3: a compact invariant set A that is transitive (has a dense orbit) and attracts a set of positive volume, its basin being the set of points whose forward orbit (or forward flow trajectory) converges to A. The finite number of attractors may depend on the element of D; no uniform bound is required. Volume-zero is independent of the choice of smooth positive density on M. This is the first bullet of Palis's Global Conjecture only; physical measures, stochastic stability, metric stability under parameter perturbation, and one-dimensional-family statements are separate conjectures not included.
honesty_statement: Formal Lean 4 proof or counterexample checked with zero sorry statements and zero custom axioms, or a verified partial reduction and barrier map. Partial progress is never labeled solved.

title: Soliton Resolution for the Focusing Energy-Critical Wave Equation without Radial Symmetry
summary: For d in {3,4,5}, consider the real focusing wave equation u_tt-Delta u=|u|^(4/(d-2))u on R^d, with energy data in dot-H1 x L2 and the usual strong energy solution on [0,infinity), uniformly bounded in that norm. Assertion: every such solution has, for all t->infinity, a decomposition of (u,u_t) into a finite-energy free wave, finitely many scaled and translated Lorentz transforms of fixed nonzero finite-energy stationary solutions, and a remainder tending to zero in dot-H1 x L2. More precisely, use the global CaseII decomposition(1.10) of DJKM1601.01871v3 with t replacing t_n: J>=0 is finite, each velocity ell_j has |ell_j|<1, lambda_j(t)>0 with lambda_j(t)/t->0, c_j(t)/t->ell_j, and for j!=k the sum lambda_j/lambda_k+lambda_k/lambda_j+|c_j-c_k|/lambda_j tends to infinity as in(1.9). No radiality, compact support, ground-state-only or distinct-velocity hypothesis is imposed.
honesty_statement: Formal Lean 4 proof or counterexample checked with zero sorry statements and zero custom axioms, or a verified partial reduction and barrier map. Partial progress is never labeled solved.

title: Brauer-Manin obstruction for number-field curves: Hasse-principle form
summary: For every number field k and every smooth projective geometrically connected curve C/k of genus at least two, if C(A_k)^Br is nonempty then C(k) is nonempty. Here Br(C)=H^2_et(C,G_m) is the full cohomological Brauer group, and C(A_k)^Br consists of adelic tuples (P_v) for which sum_v inv_v(alpha(P_v))=0 for every alpha in Br(C). Constants obey global reciprocity. Passing at archimedean places to connected components does not change nonemptiness. No rational base point, degree-one divisor class, Sha finiteness, rank bound or effective Jacobian presentation is assumed.
honesty_statement: Formal Lean 4 proof or counterexample checked with zero sorry statements and zero custom axioms, or a verified partial reduction and barrier map. Partial progress is never labeled solved.

title: Set Cover Conjecture (SeCoCo)
summary: For every fixed epsilon in(0,1), does there exist a fixed positive integer k such that no classical bounded-error randomized algorithm solves k-Set Cover in worst-case time O*(2^((1-epsilon)n))? An instance consists of an n-element universe U, an explicitly listed family F of subsets of U each of cardinality at most k, and an integer t; the decision is whether at most t members of F cover U. The algorithm must succeed with probability at least2/3 on every instance. O* hides polynomial factors in the input length. Preserve the quantifier order: k may depend on epsilon; the assertion does not prohibit a k-dependent improvement for each separately fixed k.
honesty_statement: Formal Lean 4 proof or counterexample checked with zero sorry statements and zero custom axioms, or a verified partial reduction and barrier map. Partial progress is never labeled solved.

title: Perfect-Matching Search in Deterministic NC (General Graphs)
summary: Assert the existence of one logspace-uniform family (C_n) of deterministic Boolean AND/OR/NOT circuits which, for every n>=1 and every finite simple undirected graph G on labelled vertices 1,...,n given by its n-by-n adjacency matrix, outputs a perfect matching of G if one exists and outputs a distinguished NO flag if none exists. Matching output is an n-by-n edge-indicator matrix, required to encode disjoint edges covering every vertex and belonging to G; its bits are ignored when NO is output. Circuit size is bounded by C n^c and depth by C (log(n+2))^k for constants C,c,k independent of n and G, and AND/OR fan-in is at most two. A deterministic logspace transducer on unary 1^n outputs the complete circuit description, including all designated outputs. This fixes ordinary logspace-uniform NC for the multi-output search relation. It does not conflate a search algorithm with an unweighted decision algorithm or restrict the input to bipartite or planar graphs.
honesty_statement: Formal Lean 4 proof or counterexample checked with zero sorry statements and zero custom axioms, or a verified partial reduction and barrier map. Partial progress is never labeled solved.

title: Witten's Asymptotic Expansion Conjecture for SU(2) WRT Invariants
summary: For every closed oriented three-manifold Y, let WRT_k(Y) be the SU(2) Witten-Reshetikhin-Turaev invariant at level k-2 in the standard compact-gauge normalization WRT_k(S^3)=1. For every value S in CS(Y), the set of Chern-Simons actions modulo Z of flat SU(2) connections, there should exist a formal Puiseux Laurent series W_S(tau) in union_{n>=1} C((tau^(1/n))) such that WRT_k(Y) ~ sum_{S in CS(Y)} exp(2*pi*i*k*S) W_S(1/k) as integer k tends to infinity, as a full Poincare asymptotic expansion. The separately named growth-rate and explicit leading-coefficient conjectures are not additional requirements.

title: Effective Roth Theorem
summary: There exists one total computable algorithm which, given a real algebraic irrational alpha by its integer minimal polynomial and a rational isolating interval, and a positive rational epsilon, returns an integer Q>=1 such that every reduced rational p/q, with p an integer and q>=1 an integer, satisfying |alpha-p/q|<q^(-2-epsilon) has q<=Q. The algorithm must halt with this guarantee on every valid input. No time, space, practical-size or software-implementation requirement is imposed.

title: Polynomial-Size Perfect Secret Sharing for General Access Structures
summary: Do there exist absolute constants C>0 and k>=0 such that, for every n>=1 and every nonempty upward-closed family A of subsets of [n] with the empty set not in A, a uniformly random one-bit secret S can be shared as finite-alphabet random variables X_1,...,X_n with max_i ceil(log_2 |supp(X_i)|)<=C n^k, such that every set in A reconstructs S with probability one and the joint shares of every set outside A are statistically independent of S? Schemes may be nonlinear and need not be efficiently computable. A proof of this uniform polynomial bound or its negation settles the target. The negation means that every proposed polynomial bound fails for some n and access structure; neither a full asymptotic formula nor an exponential lower bound is required.

title: Berry random-wave conjecture: real negative-curvature BS formulation
summary: For every closed connected smooth Riemannian manifold (M,g) of dimension d>=2 with everywhere strictly negative sectional curvature, put mu=dvol_g/vol_g(M). For any real orthonormal eigenbasis of L2(M,mu) for the positive Laplace-Beltrami operator, order the eigenvalues nondecreasingly and omit the finite zero-eigenspace; write Delta_g phi_j=alpha_j^2 phi_j with alpha_j>0. If p is sampled with law mu, does the law of the pointed real-decorated manifold [M,alpha_j^2 g,p,phi_j] converge weakly, along the full positive-energy sequence, in Abert-Bergeron-Le Masson's local smooth topology on pointed isometry classes of real-decorated d-manifolds, to the law of [R^d,g_Euclidean,0,F]? Here F is the centered real stationary isotropic Gaussian field with covariance E[F(x)F(y)]=integral_{S^{d-1}} cos(<x-y,theta>) d sigma(theta), where sigma is probability surface measure on the unit sphere (unit variance and unit spectral radius, no extra 2*pi factor).
honesty_statement: Formal Lean 4 proof or counterexample checked with zero sorry statements and zero custom axioms, or a verified partial reduction and barrier map. Partial progress is never labeled solved.

title: Zauner's Conjecture: Unrestricted Complex SIC Existence in Every Dimension
summary: Decide whether for EVERY integer d>=2 there exist d^2 unit vectors v_1,...,v_(d^2) in the standard complex Hilbert space C^d with |<v_i,v_j>|^2=1/(d+1) whenever i!=j. Their complex lines are distinct. Equivalently, their rank-one projectors P_i=v_i v_i^* have sum_i P_i=d I_d and define SIC-POVM elements M_i=P_i/d; for i!=j the normalized trace is Tr(M_i M_j)=1/[d^2(d+1)]. No Weyl-Heisenberg covariance, order-three symmetry, explicit coordinates or uniform construction algorithm is imposed.
honesty_statement: Formal Lean 4 proof or counterexample checked with zero sorry statements and zero custom axioms, or a verified partial reduction and barrier map. Partial progress is never labeled solved.

title: Reliability Function of the Binary Symmetric Channel Below the Critical Rate

summary: For every finite group G, every prime p, every p-block B of G with defect group D, and its Brauer correspondent b in N_G(D), the numbers k_0(B) and k_0(b) of ordinary irreducible complex characters of height zero are equal. title: Planar homogeneous Mumford–Shah local-structure conjecture
summary: Let Omega be any open subset of R^2. Consider every reduced absolute local minimizer (u,K) of E0(u,K;U)=integral_{U minus K}|grad u|^2 dx+H^1(K intersect U): K is relatively closed and countably 1-rectifiable, u is real and in W^{1,2}_loc(Omega minus K), E0 is finite on each relatively compact open U, and H^1(K intersect V)=0 implies K intersect V is empty for every open V contained in Omega. Absolute local minimality means E0(u,K;U)<=E0(v,J;U) for every relatively compact open U and every admissible locally finite-energy pair (v,J) for which (J symmetric-difference K) union the support of u-v is compactly contained in U; equality of functions off that compact set is understood almost everywhere on their common domain. There is no component-count or separation restriction on competitors. Must every x in K have a disk B_r(x) compactly contained in Omega and a C1 diffeomorphism Phi:B_r(x)->B_r(x), with Phi(x)=x and D Phi(x)=Id, such that Phi(K intersect B_r(x)) is one of: a diameter through x, one radius ending at x, or three radii ending at x with mutual120-degree angles?

title: Complex linearity of closed-surface mapping class groups by genus
summary: For every integer g >= 3, let S_g be the closed connected orientable surface of genus g and Mod(S_g) its group of isotopy classes of orientation-preserving homeomorphisms. title: Vassiliev Separation by Abelian-Valued Finite-Type Invariants
summary: For every pair of non-isotopic smooth closed oriented unframed knots K_1,K_2 in S^3, assert that there exist an abelian group A, a nonnegative integer d and an A-valued Vassiliev invariant v of order at most d with v(K_1) != v(K_2). Knots are taken up to ambient isotopy respecting their orientation, so a knot and its reverse are included when they are distinct oriented knot types. Extend v linearly from the free abelian group on oriented knot types to singular knots by the usual alternating positive/negative crossing-resolution relation; order at most d means vanishing on every singular knot with d+1 transverse double points. The coefficient group and finite order may depend on the pair. Rational-valued, integer-valued and Kontsevich-injectivity variants are related but are not asserted equivalent here.
honesty_statement: Formal Lean 4 proof or counterexample checked with zero sorry statements and zero custom axioms, or a verified partial reduction and barrier map. Partial progress is never labeled solved.

title: Grigorchuk Gap Conjecture
summary: For every finitely generated group G with finite generating set X, let gamma_G,X(n) count elements of word length at most n in X union X^(-1). For positive functions on positive integers, write f preceq g if some integer C>=1 satisfies f(n)<=C g(Cn) for every n>=1, and f prec g if f preceq g but not g preceq f. Prove that gamma_G,X prec exp(sqrt(n)) implies that G has polynomial growth, equivalently that G is virtually nilpotent. The growth comparison is independent of the finite generating set. It is strict comparison of growth classes, not merely an eventual numerical upper bound or non-strict domination.
honesty_statement: Formal Lean 4 proof or counterexample checked with zero sorry statements and zero custom axioms, or a verified partial reduction and barrier map. Partial progress is never labeled solved.

title: Margulis–Zimmer Commensurated-Subgroup Conjecture over Number Fields
summary: For every number field K, connected absolutely almost simple simply connected algebraic K-group G, finite set S of places containing all archimedean places, and subgroup Gamma of G(K) commensurable with G(O_S), suppose the sum over v in S of rank over K_v of G is at least two. For every subgroup N of Gamma such that N intersect gamma N gamma^(-1) has finite index in both N and gamma N gamma^(-1) for all gamma in Gamma, assert that N is finite or is commensurable with G(O_Sprime) for some set Sprime with all archimedean places contained in Sprime contained in S. Here O_S is the ring of S-integers and commensurability is inside G(K). Prove this universal assertion or give a counterexample. The target includes anisotropic/cocompact arithmetic lattices and mixed archimedean/nonarchimedean higher S-rank; it is not restricted to the non-uniform real-lattice cases.

title: Zagier Conjecture on Dedekind Zeta Values
summary: For every number field F of signature (r1,r2) and every integer k>=2, put n=r2 for even k and n=r1+r2 for odd k. There exist xi_1,...,xi_n in A_k(F) tensor Q, using the allowable-symbol group defined by Zagier--Gangl section2, such that zeta_F(k) belongs to Q^times times sqrt(abs(D_F)) pi^{k([F:Q]-n)} det(L_k(sigma_i(xi_j)))_{1<=i,j<=n}. Here L_k is the single-valued polylogarithm defined there by the Bernoulli-number combination of classical polylogarithms (imaginary part for even k, real part for odd k), extended Q-linearly to symbols. For even k take one embedding from each conjugate complex pair; for odd k also take all real embeddings. The empty determinant is1. This is existence of the determinant formula, not the stronger regulator-lattice or Bloch-group rank assertion.

title: Tits Alternative for CAT(0) Groups
summary: Prove or disprove that every CAT(0) group satisfies the Tits alternative: if a discrete group G acts properly and cocompactly by isometries on a proper CAT(0) geodesic metric space, then every finitely generated subgroup H of G is either virtually solvable or contains a subgroup isomorphic to the free group F_2. Proper for the space means that closed bounded sets are compact; no geodesic-completeness, cube-complex or fixed-dimension hypothesis is imposed. Success is a proof for every such G and H, or a counterexample G,H violating both alternatives.

title: Arnold Chord Conjecture in Higher Dimensions
summary: Prove that for every closed co-oriented contact manifold (Y, xi) of dimension 2n+1 with n >= 2, every contact form alpha for xi, and every closed Legendrian submanifold Lambda of Y, there exists a Reeb chord of Lambda: a non-constant trajectory of the Reeb vector field of alpha starting and ending on Lambda. Hutchings-Taubes proved the three-dimensional case (all Legendrian knots in all closed contact 3-manifolds); the conjecture is open in higher dimensions apart from special cases (subcritical Stein boundaries, conormal bundles, convex hypersurfaces).

title: Néel Order for the Spin-1/2 Square-Lattice Heisenberg Antiferromagnet (Averaged Ground-State Order)

title: Chowla Non-Vanishing Conjecture for Dirichlet L-Functions at the Central Point
summary: For every integer q>=1 and every primitive Dirichlet character chi of conductor q, including real and nonreal characters and both even and odd parity, the analytically continued Dirichlet L-function satisfies L(1/2,chi) != 0. The conductor-one character is included with L(s,chi)=zeta(s), whose central value is already known to be nonzero; conductors with no primitive characters contribute no cases. No positivity, quantitative lower bound, effective constant or off-central zero-free region is part of the assertion.
honesty_statement: Formal Lean 4 proof or counterexample checked with zero sorry statements and zero custom axioms, or a verified partial reduction and barrier map. Partial progress is never labeled solved.

title: Tutte's 3-Flow Conjecture
summary: Every finite loopless multigraph G that is 4-edge-connected admits a nowhere-zero integer 3-flow: there exist an orientation D of E(G) and a function f:E(G)->{-2,-1,1,2} such that at each vertex the sum of f on incoming edges equals the sum on outgoing edges. Four-edge-connected means G remains connected after deletion of any set of at most3 edges. Parallel edges are allowed. Trivial one-vertex loopless graphs have the empty flow. This is the ordinary zero-boundary flow assertion, not the stronger claim of realizing every admissible prescribed boundary modulo3.

title: Corona problem for the unit polydisc

title: Arithmeticity of Lattices in PU(n,1) for n at Least 4
summary: For every integer n>=4, every lattice Γ in PU(n,1), the group of holomorphic isometries of complex hyperbolic n-space, is arithmetic. A lattice is a discrete subgroup of finite Haar covolume; both compact and noncompact finite-volume quotients and groups with torsion are included. Arithmeticity has its usual commensurability meaning via arithmetic subgroups of algebraic groups over Q projected through a compact-kernel real-group homomorphism, equivalently after the finite central lift to SU(n,1). No restriction to reflection lattices or one particular arithmetic construction is imposed. Here n is complex dimension, not real rank.
honesty_statement: Formal Lean 4 proof or counterexample checked with zero sorry statements and zero custom axioms, or a verified partial reduction and barrier map. Partial progress is never labeled solved.

title: Hilbert's Tenth Problem over C(t) with named t
summary: Let t be a fixed transcendental indeterminate and C(t) the field of complex rational functions. title: Igusa’s Standard p-Adic Monodromy Conjecture
summary: For every n≥1 and nonconstant f∈Q[x_1,...,x_n], there is a finite set S_f of primes such that for every p outside S_f, every complex-valued locally constant compactly supported function phi on Q_p^n, and every actual pole s_0 of the meromorphic continuation of Z_p(f,phi;s)=integral |f(x)|_p^s phi(x) dx, exp(2*pi*i*Re(s_0)) is an eigenvalue of the local complex monodromy of f at some point of {f=0}⊂C^n. Haar measure is normalized by vol(Z_p^n)=1; the nonzero normalization does not affect poles. This is the standard assertion of Veys Conjecture 2.12(1); S_f depends on f, not on phi. Strong Bernstein–Sato, origin-only, differential-form, topological, motivic and character variants are not silently identified with it.
honesty_statement: Formal Lean 4 proof or counterexample checked with zero sorry statements and zero custom axioms, or a verified partial reduction and barrier map. Partial progress is never labeled solved.

title: Ivrii conjecture on periodic billiard orbits
summary: For every integer n>=2 and every bounded connected open domain Ω in Euclidean R^n with C∞ boundary, prove the following assertion; neither convexity nor simple connectivity is assumed. Let M=B*∂Ω={(x,η) in T*∂Ω: |η|<1}, with the norm induced by the Euclidean metric and canonical symplectic (Liouville) volume μ=|ω^(n-1)|/(n-1)!, where ω is the canonical symplectic form. The billiard map β lifts (x,η) to the inward-pointing unit covector, follows the straight segment to its first subsequent boundary collision, and applies specular reflection, recording the tangential covector at that collision. Let M_reg be the set on which every forward and backward iterate is well-defined and nongrazing. For P=union over integers k>=2 of {z in M_reg: β^k(z)=z}, prove μ(P)=0. The integer k need not be the least period. Grazing collisions and any undefined singular continuation are excluded from M_reg; no rule continuing through them is imposed.

title: Pugh–Shub Stable Ergodicity (C^r Density in Partial Hyperbolicity)
summary: For every compact connected boundaryless smooth manifold M with a smooth probability volume m, and every r in [2,infinity] (including the C^infinity topology), is the following true? In the space PH_m^r(M) of volume-preserving C^r partially hyperbolic diffeomorphisms, maps that are C^1-stably ergodic among C^2 volume-preserving diffeomorphisms are C^r-dense. Thus every f in PH_m^r(M) and every relative C^r neighborhood U of f contain g such that some C^1 neighborhood V of g has every C^2 volume-preserving h in V ergodic for m. Use the usual C^r topology, with the Holder convention for nonintegral finite r. Partial hyperbolicity means a continuous Df-invariant dominated splitting TM=E^u+E^c+E^s: E^u and E^s are nontrivial, E^c may be zero, and for some common integer N>=1 the unstable unit vectors expand by >2, stable unit vectors contract by <1/2, and earlier nonzero bundles dominate later ones by a factor >2 under Df^N, pointwise at the same base point in that order. This is the ACW stability convention with the r>=2 range documented by RHRHU, not density among all conservative diffeomorphisms or only C^1-density.
honesty_statement: Formal Lean 4 proof or counterexample checked with zero sorry statements and zero custom axioms, or a verified partial reduction and barrier map. Partial progress is never labeled solved.

title: Conforti–Cornuéjols Conjecture: Packing Property Implies Max-Flow Min-Cut
summary: For every finite clutter H, prove or disprove that its packing property implies its max-flow min-cut property. Use the following precise linear-programming convention, with M the edge-by-vertex0/1 incidence matrix: the packing property says that min{w^T x:Mx>=1,x>=0}=max{1^T y:M^T y<=w,y>=0} has integral optimal solutions on both sides for every w in {0,1,+infinity}^V for which the optimum is finite. An infinite cost forces that primal coordinate to0 and omits the corresponding dual upper-bound constraint. The MFMC property requires integral optimal solutions on both sides for every finite nonnegative integral w. Equivalently, packing means the covering/edge-packing min-max equality holds for all minors with the usual feasible-case convention. The reverse implication MFMC implies packing is already known.

title: Coleman-Oort conjecture: eventual special-subvariety exclusion
summary: There exists an integer g0 such that for every integer g>=g0 the complex Siegel moduli space A_g of principally polarized abelian varieties contains no positive-dimensional irreducible special (Shimura) subvariety S generically contained in the smooth-Jacobian Torelli locus T_g^o. Precisely, if T_g is the Zariski closure of the image of the moduli of smooth genus-g complex curves under the Torelli map, the prohibited S satisfies S subset T_g and S intersection T_g^o nonempty, hence open dense in S. No fixed, optimal or effective threshold is prescribed. The statement excludes neither isolated CM points nor special subvarieties wholly in the decomposable boundary.

The quantifier requires an ACTUAL integer witness at the closed bound, not merely an infimum no greater than the bound. Equivalently, scaling a general real nonsingular matrix B and its translation by |det B|^(-1/n) gives the same actual-witness assertion with bound |det B|/2^n; all coefficients and translations are real. No equality characterization of extremal lattices, well-rounded Euclidean covering assertion, positive-characteristic analogue or constructive algorithm is appended. Preserve all dimensions, not merely a selected high-dimensional open remainder.
honesty_statement: Formal Lean 4 proof or counterexample checked with zero sorry statements and zero custom axioms, or a verified partial reduction and barrier map. Partial progress is never labeled solved.

title: Zilber's Exponential-Algebraic Closedness Conjecture
summary: For every positive integer n and irreducible complex algebraic subvariety V of C^n x (C*)^n which is free and rotund, decide whether V contains (z,exp(z)) for some z in C^n. Free means that neither projection is contained in a translate of a proper Q-defined linear subspace or a proper algebraic subtorus, respectively. Rotund means dim(pi_L(V)) >= n-dim(L) for every Q-defined complex linear subspace L of C^n, where pi_L is the quotient to C^n/L x (C*)^n/exp(L). This is ordinary exponential-algebraic closedness, without an extra generic-transcendence-degree requirement.
honesty_statement: Formal Lean 4 proof or counterexample checked with zero sorry statements and zero custom axioms, or a verified partial reduction and barrier map. Partial progress is never labeled solved.

title: Boundedness of Compact Hyperkahler Manifolds: Finiteness of Deformation Types in Each Dimension
summary: For each integer n>=1, are there only finitely many deformation-equivalence classes of compact irreducible holomorphic symplectic complex manifolds of complex dimension 2n? Such a manifold is smooth, simply connected and compact Kähler, with H^0(X,Omega_X^2) spanned by a holomorphic two-form nondegenerate everywhere. Deformation equivalence is the equivalence generated by occurrence as fibers in smooth proper holomorphic families of such manifolds over connected bases. No projectivity, polarization, lattice, second-Betti-number or fibration restriction is imposed. Resolve by proving finiteness in every fixed dimension or showing infinitely many deformation classes in one fixed dimension.

title: Erdős Matching Conjecture
summary: For all positive integers k,s,n with n>=ks, let F be a family of distinct k-element subsets of [n]={1,...,n} containing no s pairwise disjoint members. The conjecture asserts |F|<=max{binom(ks-1,k), binom(n,k)-binom(n-s+1,k)}. Here binom(a,k)=0 for integers 0<=a<k. For s=1 the family is empty, and k=1 is included as a trivial case. The two terms are attained by all k-subsets of a fixed (ks-1)-set and by all k-subsets meeting a fixed (s-1)-set, respectively. Their role is sharpness of the bound, not an additional classification of all equality families.

title: Congruence Subgroup Property for Automorphism Groups of Free Groups
summary: For every integer n>=3, let F_n be the free group on n generators. title: Dynamical Manin–Mumford Conjecture: Special-Subvariety Formulation
summary: For every smooth projective variety X over a field K of characteristic zero, every polarizable endomorphism f:X→X and every subvariety Z⊆X containing a Zariski-dense set of f-preperiodic geometric points, Z is dynamically special: there exist an integer n≥1, a subvariety Y with Z⊆Y⊆X, and a polarizable endomorphism g:X→X such that f^n(Y)=Y=g(Y), f^n∘g=g∘f^n on Y, and g^a(Z)=g^b(Z) for some integers 0≤a<b. Polarizable means h*L≅L^⊗d for some ample line bundle L and integer d>1, separately for each endomorphism h; geometric points are taken over an algebraic closure.

title: Trifference Problem: Exponential Rate of Ternary Perfect 3-Hash Codes
summary: For n>=1 let T(n) be the largest cardinality of a set C subset {0,1,2}^n such that every three distinct words x,y,z in C have some coordinate i with {x_i,y_i,z_i}={0,1,2}. Determine R_3 = limsup as n tends to infinity of log_2(T(n))/n by proving matching asymptotic lower and upper bounds. Resolution requires identifying the value of R_3, not merely improving one side, computing finitely many T(n), or restating this variational definition. Codes are unrestricted, not necessarily linear. The chosen entity is the classical ternary k=3 problem, not the simultaneous determination of every perfect k-hash rate.

title: Plurality Is Stablest: Balanced Positive-Correlation Clause

summary: For every finite irreducible complex reflection group W, let B(W) be its braid group and R=Z[u_(s,j)^(+/-1)] the generic Laurent parameter ring, with parameters identified for conjugate distinguished reflections s and j=1,...,e_s. Let H(W) be R[B(W)] modulo product_j(T_s-u_(s,j))=0 for each distinguished braid reflection. Is there an R-linear symmetrizing trace tau:H(W)->R, meaning tau(xy)=tau(yx) and the pairing (x,y)->tau(xy) identifies H(W) with its R-dual, such that specialization u_(s,j)=exp(2*pi*i*j/e_s) gives the identity-coefficient trace on the group algebra, and tau(T_(b^-1))^* tau(T_pi)=tau(T_(b*pi)) for every braid b? Here * inverts all parameters, z is the standard positive generator of the braid-group center, and pi=z^|Z(W)| is the full twist. The specialization makes tau(T_pi) nonzero, so the last identity is equivalent to the usual quotient normalization. Prove existence for all W or give a counterexample. Reducible reflection groups are covered by tensor products; no explicit lifted basis or algorithm is additionally demanded.
honesty_statement: Formal Lean 4 proof or counterexample checked with zero sorry statements and zero custom axioms, or a verified partial reduction and barrier map. Partial progress is never labeled solved.

title: Wirsing's Conjecture on Approximation by Algebraic Numbers of Bounded Degree
summary: For every positive integer n and every transcendental real number xi, w_n^*(xi)>=n. Here w_n^*(xi) is the supremum of real w such that 0<|xi-alpha|<=H(alpha)^(-w-1) for infinitely many real algebraic numbers alpha of degree at most n, and H(alpha) is the maximum absolute coefficient of its primitive irreducible minimal polynomial over Z. Equivalently the approximation inequality with exponent n+1-epsilon holds for infinitely many such alpha for every epsilon>0.
honesty_statement: Formal Lean 4 proof or counterexample checked with zero sorry statements and zero custom axioms, or a verified partial reduction and barrier map. Partial progress is never labeled solved.

steps.statement: Write a clean, axiom-free Lean 4 statement capturing the exact target of Bourgain-Lindenstrauss periodic equidistribution conjecture: Prove that if (mu_n) is a sequence of ergodic finitely supported probability measures on T invariant under both x2 and x3 with |supp(mu_n)| -> infinity, then mu_n converges in the vague topology to the Lebesgue measure lambda.
steps.context: ProofMath 500 #499 (Probability, ergodic theory & dynamics, status: open). The conjecture asks whether the two simultaneous invariances force these increasingly large finite configurations to become uniformly distributed, in the stated vague topology. Source: P. Burton, J. Panangaden, 'Formulations of Furstenberg's x2 x3 conjecture in complex analysis and operator algebras', arXiv:2410.22701 (2024). (https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2410.22701)

title: Berge-Fulkerson conjecture
summary: Prove or disprove that every finite bridgeless cubic graph has six perfect matchings, counted with multiplicity, such that every edge belongs to exactly two of the six matchings.
